name: computer_core_2
title: Computer Core 2 (ALPHA)
author: SirEdvin; original Computer Core by Relik77 and contributors
description: ALPHA - experimental Factorio 2.0 port of Computer Core. Programmable Lua computers, shell/filesystem, named persistent handlers, circuits, wireless networking and personal gauntlet. Fresh 2.0 worlds only; no legacy saves or persisted-closure compatibility. Headless base/expansion save-reload tests pass; client GUI, sound, wired robot blueprints and multiplayer acceptance remain unverified. Back up saves; expect bugs and API changes.
